dedupe_keys.name: dostupnost zeleznicnich stanic a zastavek v olomouckem kraji

description: Dostupnost železničních stanic a zastávek v Olomouckém kraji is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Olomoucký kraj. Analysis of the availability of the public infrastructure of the Olomouc Region 2024 - railway station/stop. Coverage: Olomoucký kraj. The portal shows the English title as "Availability of railway stations and stops in the Olomouc Region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Olomoucký kraj. Its keywords include Olomoucký kraj, opendata, dopravní infrastruktura, územní plánování, Dostupnost. The listing shows 6 download or service links in GEOJSON, ZIP, CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/60609460/6ec86124435784f0b310e18599832e6d/distribuce/c608517c6b71098c21815afc50b51669/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
